meta.name: team-communication-protocols
meta.description: Structured messaging protocols for agent team communication including message type selection, plan approval, shutdown procedures, and anti-patterns to avoid. Use this skill when establishing communication norms for a newly spawned team, when deciding whether to send a direct message or a broadcast, when a team-lead needs to review and approve an implementer's plan before work begins, when orchestrating a graceful team shutdown after all tasks are complete, or when debugging why teammates are not coordinating correctly at integration points.

copy.tagline: 规范智能体团队的沟通与协作流程
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果正在开发多智能体系统,需要统一团队通信规则
copy.fit_line_en: For you if building multi-agent systems and need clear messaging protocols.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会按固定消息协议与队友协作:区分直接消息与广播、用 plan_approval_request 走计划审批、用 shutdown_request 优雅关闭团队,并规避常见沟通反模式。
howto.when: 当新建团队需要确立沟通规范、在直接消息与广播之间做选择,或要处理计划审批与团队关闭等情形时触发。

say.text: 帮团队定沟通规范:常规更新用直接消息,别用广播
say.note: lead 会按协议选消息类型

say.text: 把队友的计划发我审批,通过后再开工
任务都完成了,按流程优雅关闭团队

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude coordinates with teammate agents using fixed protocols: it picks direct messages vs broadcasts, routes plan approval via plan_approval_request, sends shutdown_request for graceful teardown, and avoids the listed anti-patterns.
howto.when_en: Triggers when a new team needs communication norms, when choosing between direct messages and broadcasts, or when handling plan approval and graceful team shutdown.

say_en.text: Set team communication norms: routine updates by direct message, not broadcast
say_en.note: lead picks message type per protocol

say_en.text: Send me the teammate's plan for approval before work starts
All tasks are done — shut the team down gracefully
